trust.description: Reading problems is supported; compiling and running requires a trusted workspace.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.ui.language: AC-Stride interface language. Does not translate problem statements or code.
[Open AC-Stride settings panel](command:codeforcesWorkbench.openSettings)

AC-Stride interface language. Does not translate problem statements or code.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.codeforces.h: Optional public read-only Codeforces handle for submission results and nearby ranking. No account authentication is performed.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.python.inter: Python 3 executable or absolute path. On Windows you may need to set this to python. For virtual environments, use the interpreter's full path.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.python.args: Additional Python interpreter arguments. AC-Stride adds unbuffered UTF-8 execution flags.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.python.templ: Optional absolute path to a Python template; supports ${PROBLEM_ID}.
Starter Python code for new solutions. Supports ${PROBLEM_ID}. Leave empty to use the template file or built-in default. Existing code is never replaced.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.cpp.template: Starter C++ code for new solutions. Supports ${PROBLEM_ID}. Leave empty to use the template file or built-in default. Existing code is never replaced.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.cpp.compiler: C++ compiler executable or absolute path.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.cpp.args: Compiler arguments, passed without a shell.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.cpp.template: Optional absolute path to a C++ template; supports ${PROBLEM_ID}.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.solution.def: Default programming language for newly imported contests, Codeforces problems and local practice.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.java.templat: Optional absolute path to a Java template; supports ${PROBLEM_ID}.
Starter Java code for new solutions. Supports ${PROBLEM_ID}. Leave empty to use the template file or built-in default. Existing code is never replaced.
setting.codeforcesWorkbench.kotlin.templ: Optional absolute path to a Kotlin template; supports ${PROBLEM_ID}.
Starter Kotlin code for new solutions. Supports ${PROBLEM_ID}. Leave empty to use the template file or built-in default. Existing code is never replaced.
